gaps: Division leaders for the markets below: not fully confirmed; no web search was run. This file rests on the 2026 proxy, the FY2025 10-K and annual report, the company's investor press-release feed (2024-2026: earnings and board releases only), the full M/I Homes blog (722 posts crawled and searched for leadership titles), the company's PR Newswire release index, Texas Comptroller records, and local builder-association pages.

Area Presidents not found for 10 of 17 divisions (no 2025-2026 public source opened): Columbus, Cincinnati, Indianapolis, Minneapolis/St. Paul (Northern); Tampa, Orlando, Raleigh, Houston, Austin, San Antonio (Southern). Detroit, Sarasota and Fort Myers/Naples have names only from 2018-2023 sources (tagged Inferred).
San Antonio: a 2019 company blog post mentions a 'Division President Derek' (surname not given); not recorded as a row.

Division and regional land leaders (VP / Director of Land Acquisition, Development, Entitlement): none confirmed on any company page, release or filing opened in this run. The company does not publish division leadership pages. Eight division 'VP of Land' names seen only in directory search snippets are already recorded as Inferred in m-i-homes.people.json and are not repeated here. A former 'Regional Vice President of Land' role existed (Ed Suchora held it about 2016-2018); current holder not found.

Texas Comptroller franchise-tax records for M/I Homes of Houston, San Antonio, Austin and DFW LLCs (report year 2025) list only the corporate officers (Schottenstein, Creek, Krohne), so they do not identify division leaders.

Builder-association rosters: the Cincinnati, Charlotte, Raleigh, Austin, San Antonio, Dallas, Middle Tennessee, Lee County (FL), Greater Chicago and SE Michigan board/council pages fetched in this run do not list an M/I Homes person; Indianapolis (BAGI), Houston (GHBA), Tampa (TBBA), Minnesota (Housing First MN) and Sarasota-Manatee pages blocked automated access. Florida Sunbiz entity records also blocked access.

Reporting lines: Area President to Region President is Verified from the 2026 proxy (which names each Region President's divisions) plus the 10-K (Area Presidents are supervised by a Region President). Region President to CEO is inferred; the proxy does not state it.
No separate brands or subsidiaries with their own president: all homebuilding runs under the M/I Homes name (M/I Financial, the mortgage and title arm, is covered in the corporate file).
